reasoning: Illinois is structurally very Democratic; its statewide Cook PVI is about D+15. In the last 45 days, I did not find any credible Illinois-specific general-election Senate or presidential polling from an approved source, so the only usable current-race evidence here is absent; the available election-forecast material instead points to a very safe Democratic baseline, with one forecast showing Democrats favored by about 19.5 points in the Illinois Senate race.
